Rome —
They are two of the world’s best-known Bobs from the US Midwest. Now Pope Leo XIV, whose birth name is Robert Prevost, and Bob Dylan, the legendary musician, have met in the Vatican.
Leo and Dylan were both seen meeting in the Vatican’s apostolic palace, the pope’s residence, on Wednesday. The pope was wearing his white cassock and Dylan a black coat, black gloves and a black hoodie.
The meeting was brokered by Rev. Antonio Spadaro, a Vatican official known for building bridges between the church and wider culture. Spadaro earlier this year arranged a meeting between Pope Leo and Patti Smith.

item.title: Bomb threats hit several flights in Europe, reports say
item.description:
• Bomb threats forced the diversion of more than a dozen flights across Europe on Thursday, the latest in a string of incidents disrupting airspace. Several authorities have said no devices have been found.
• Four of the flight diversions were in the Czech Republic. The bomb threats were made in an anonymous email and other airports received the email too, a representative of the Václav Havel Airport in Prague told CNN.
• A company linked to Rome’s airport received an email from a group purporting to be anti-feminist and calling itself the Male State that claimed there were bombs on two flights. But it is unconfirmed who was behind the wave of threats and the EU says it is too early to say they are linked.

item.title: Spanish transport minister resigns after two deadly train crashes in one year
item.description: Spain’s Minister of Transport Óscar Puente announced his resignation after two deadly train crashes occurred in a single year, including one last week that killed 69 people.

item.title: Warsaw-Modlin airport reopens after bomb threat; second flight checked at Chopin
item.description: Warsaw-Modlin airport reopened around midday on Tuesday after a bomb threat alert forced a passenger plane from London to make an unscheduled landing there, while another plane from Copenhagen was checked at Warsaw-Chopin airport for the same reason.
